acceptance: A closed deterministic transition table defines every allowed in-place Run state transition and rejects every undeclared transition without consulting time, randomness, network, models, or persistence.
COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED, and BLOCKED cannot transition back to RUNNING in place; continuation is represented by a distinct child Run so historical state is preserved.

Continuation validation requires a distinct child identity, parentRunId bound to the parent Run, child state PLANNED, and exact target revision equality; mismatches fail closed with stable machine-readable issues.
Existing SG-000011 RunRecord validation remains compatible and unchanged; lifecycle semantics compose on top of the existing protocol contract rather than redefining it.
Focused tests cover the complete transition matrix plus continuation success/failure cases and deterministic repeated results.

Any implementation candidate must pass repository format/lint/typecheck/tests, truthful Diffcipline proof, checksum-verified Alibaba Open Code Review, required credentialed Jev semantic review, exact-head CI, normal merge, and fresh-main CI before closure.

required: Exact base/head/merge-base and complete changed-file accounting.
Complete transition-matrix tests and continuation/resume invariant tests plus full repository verification.
Diffcipline proof, Alibaba OCR evidence, credentialed Jev semantic review, exact-head semantic review, and post-merge fresh-main CI.

minimality.rationale: Reuse SG-000011 RunRecord/RunState identities and validators. The smallest dependency-unlocking P03 slice is pure lifecycle and continuation semantics; persistence, budgets, artifacts, and execution remain separate later Grains.

requirements: Lifecycle state and parentRunId are evidence/coordination semantics only and never grant capabilities, credentials, network access, deployment authority, or provider authority.
Resume preserves history through a distinct child Run and must not rewrite a terminal parent into RUNNING.
Lifecycle validation is deterministic, side-effect free, provider-neutral, and fail-closed for undeclared transitions or target mismatches.

outcome: The harness has a deterministic provider-neutral Run lifecycle contract with explicit allowed transitions, terminal-state behavior, cancellation/blocking semantics, and parent/child continuation rules before any persistence adapter or model/provider work is introduced.
rationale: SG-000011 established validated Run/Event/Evidence/Finding record shapes and Run states, but it intentionally did not define legal Run state transitions or resume/continuation semantics. P03-S01 requires Run lifecycle, cancellation, and resume behavior before the event store can become authoritative.

risk.recovery: Revert only the P03 Run lifecycle module, exports, and focused tests; SG-000011 protocol record contracts and P01 control-plane persistence remain unchanged.

scope_in: Define a pure deterministic Run lifecycle transition contract over the existing PLANNED, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED, and BLOCKED states without changing the canonical RunRecord wire shape.
Define explicit terminal/closed-state behavior so COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED, and BLOCKED cannot silently return to RUNNING by in-place mutation.
Define a provider-neutral continuation/resume contract in which a resumed attempt is a distinct child Run with parentRunId pointing to the prior Run, preserving the prior Run as historical evidence.
Require a continuation child to start in PLANNED state and remain bound to the same exact target revision as its parent; a changed target is a distinct Run rather than a resume.
Add deterministic focused tests for allowed/forbidden transitions, terminal behavior, valid and invalid continuation, target mismatch, and order-independent validation outcomes.
scope_out: No event-store persistence adapter, database schema, Supabase mutation, artifact store, budget accounting, scheduler, model/provider routing, network access, secret handling, wall-clock policy, retry execution, or P02 changes.
No modification to SG-000011 Run/Event/Evidence/Finding JSON wire contracts and no migration of existing canonical records.
No automatic resume execution and no capability or permission grant from Run state, parentRunId, or lifecycle validation.
title: IN-P03-S01-T01A deterministic Run lifecycle and continuation semantics
